ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 15% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in linear and circular patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white markings are distributed globally; dense white clustering at the basal midline; multiple high-contrast linear streaks (white) oriented diagonally and horizontally across both lobes; scattered circular white spots throughout.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch located at the central axis, dividing the lobes with a sharp interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with low-amplitude peaks along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to high-frequency, irregular jagged protrusions at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge, exhibiting a symmetric taper from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ovoid high-intensity white rings and solid clusters distributed across the medial and lateral surfaces, indicative of barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned white linear tracks (rake marks) crossing the black ventral surface; particularly dense cross-hatching visible on the right lobe (camera-right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, irregular clusters of calcified barnacle colonies or scarring at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes, creating a non-linear, jagged profile.
